description: This file defines the Polymer.Behavior 'IronFormElementBehavior', a web component behavior used to enable custom elements to participate in forms within the Polymer library. It includes property definitions, lifecycle methods (attached and detached), and event firing related to form registration.

methods.name: attached
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the element is attached to the DOM; fires 'iron-form-element-register' event.

methods.name: detached
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the element is detached from the DOM; fires 'iron-form-element-unregister' event if a parent form exists.
